text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both rallying with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin's gains, suggesting renewed confidence in both layer-1 platforms and risk appetite for alts. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 56 while Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 58.4%, indicating this is a broad-based rally rather than a concentrated Bitcoin surge. Volume at $128B shows solid participation, though without trending higher it suggests cautious rather than euphoric sentiment.
